page_title: INT 2-0 MON | Inter v Monza 19/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+3' Marko Arnautovic (Inter) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender.
90+2' Inter force a corner. They send men into the box.
90+2' Inter force their opponents to concede a corner.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
89' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Inter.
88' Monza failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

87' Carlos Augusto (Inter) was the quickest one to orientate himself inside the box and rose high to reach a fine corner kick. He fails to direct the ball past the goalkeeper as it flies narrowly over the bar.
87' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Inter.
86' Substitution. Valentin Carboni (Monza) replaces Georgios Kyriakopoulos.
83' Simone Inzaghi decides to make a substitution. Matteo Darmian will be replaced by Yann Aurel Bisseck (Inter).
80' It will be a substitution. Davide Frattesi (Inter) is ready to enter the pitch as Lautaro Martinez walks off.
76' 2 - 0 Goal! A precise cut back on the goal line from Marko Arnautovic finds Lautaro Martinez (Inter) right in front of goal, and he easily buries the ball into the bottom right corner. 2:0.
73' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.
72' Pedro Pereira (Monza) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball. A free kick is awarded to Inter.
70' Substitution. Danilo D'Ambrosio makes way for Pedro Pereira (Monza).
70' Substitution. Roberto Gagliardini leaves the pitch and is replaced by Jose Machin (Monza).
67' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Marko Arnautovic (Inter) comes onto the pitch for Marcus Thuram.
67' Simone Inzaghi has decided to make a change. Juan Cuadrado (Inter) replaces Denzel Dumfries.
67' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Carlos Augusto (Inter) comes onto the pitch so that Federico Dimarco can be given a rest.
66' What a big chance! Federico Dimarco (Inter) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball a whisker wide of the right post.
65' Samuele Birindelli (Monza) goes close to scoring with a shot from inside the box, but he sends his effort over the crossbar.
63' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) unleashes a shot towards the goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies high over the bar.
60' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Samuele Birindelli (Monza) is coming onto the pitch as Andrea Colpani cannot continue after picking up an injury.
60' Substitution. Dany Mota (Monza) on for Mirko Maric.
60' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) drives in a shot at goal, but the attempt from the edge of the box flashes just over the bar.
59' One of the Monza players unfairly tackled his opponent and conceded a foul. Inter are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
57' Gianluca Caprari (Monza) commits a foul during an attacking move.
55' The Monza players are exchanging some short passes.
54' Dangerous play by Federico Dimarco (Inter). Andrea Colombo blows his whistle for a foul.
53' Federico Dimarco (Inter) has a good chance to get on the scoresheet and fires the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar.
50' Andrea Colpani (Monza) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
48' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' Andrea Colombo blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
43' A run and shot from the edge of the box by Federico Dimarco (Inter) causes Michele Di Gregorio little worry as it's towards the middle of the goal. Easy save.
43' Gianluca Caprari (Monza) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
41' What was Luca Caldirola (Monza) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
40' Stefan de Vrij (Inter) makes a rough challenge and Andrea Colombo blows his whistle for a foul.
39' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
36' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
36' Monza control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
32' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Andrea Colombo had an easy-decision to make.
31' Ooh that was close! Federico Dimarco (Inter) collects a pass and runs with pace goalwards before unleashing a great drive from the edge of the box, but it goes inches wide of the right post.
28' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) gets to the ball from the resulting corner but blazes it well over the bar.
28' Inter have been awarded a corner kick.
26' A cooling break is underway.
25' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
22' A snap shot by Roberto Gagliardini (Monza) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom left corner, but Yann Sommer produces a good save to thwart him.
22' Gianluca Caprari (Monza) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
21' Gianluca Caprari (Monza) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
20' Inter take a short corner kick.
18' Mirko Maric (Monza) beats his man to the lofted pass, but his header sails harmlessly well wide of the right post from close range.
14' Andrea Colpani (Monza) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
12' Andrea Colpani (Monza) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.

12' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Monza will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
10' The Monza players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
8' 1 - 0 Goal! A precise cut back on the goal line from Denzel Dumfries finds Lautaro Martinez (Inter) right in front of goal, and he easily buries the ball into the bottom left corner. 1:0.
7' Inter take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
6' Marcus Thuram (Inter) is first to the rebound inside the box but sends his effort high over the bar.
5' A pass by Danilo D'Ambrosio (Monza) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Monza will take the kick-off.
Andrea Colombo got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
